groupBrief:
Maintainer decision (2026-10-01), replacing the 2026-09-30 App-merge proposal: for Orbit task PRs, use a final DevOps review comment plus green CI, then merge the reviewed commit through the maintainer's GitHub CLI profile. When the maintainer delegates final review and merge for named work, the reviewer records the full PR head SHA, verification results, limitations, evidence links, and an explicit ready-to-merge verdict in a GitHub comment. A formal GitHub approving review is optional. The final assessment covers the whole PR and confirms independent review evidence; subtask approvals alone are insufficient.

Before an immediate merge, confirm Required checks succeeded on that same head, blocking findings are resolved, required verification is complete, and the PR head still matches. Use gh pr merge <pr-url> --merge --match-head-commit <reviewed-sha>. A changed head requires renewed review, affected checks, and an updated verdict. Missing, unreadable, pending, or failed required checks prevent merge. Verify the merged state and record the merge commit; the existing scheduler completes the task on its next tick.

The maintainer profile has admin bypass. These are reviewer workflow checks, not a new GitHub- or Gateway-enforced gate. Preserve the ruleset and bypass. Do not add tasks:merge, a Gateway endpoint, SDK/MCP/API contracts, App permissions, required GitHub approvals, or auto-merge. Defer the earlier App merge operation and ruleset change.

Contract and planning artifacts are on branch task-677 from 0f493f3f505815da3b1d800ab2afeb26d4f5e32f. Scope is documentation and agent guidance only; the existing uncommitted orbit-tasks skill edit in the primary workspace is separate. Planned documentation/guidance paths are listed in .loop/planned-paths.json; full impact evidence is .loop/docs-impact.json. No new ADR is needed for this reversible contributor workflow; rationale belongs in docs/reference/implementation-loop.md. Two dependency-ordered subtasks each fit one session. Keep the group in backlog until the revised breakdown is approved for dispatch.

tasks.title: Document the final-review comment and maintainer merge workflow
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** Make the agreed final-review gate clear for Orbit task PRs.

**Contract:** docs/reference/implementation-loop.md#final-review-of-an-orbit-task-pull-request and #the-maintainer-approves-every-merge; docs/contributor-guide.md#review-and-merge; docs/reference/tasks.md#settling.

**Builds on:** None. Start from the prepared contract on task-677.

**Deliverables:**
- Feature delivery describes a final comment for the exact head, checks/evidence/limitations/verdict, delegated authorization, successful Required checks on that head, immediate merge through the maintainer profile with --match-head-commit, re-review after head changes, and scheduler completion.
- Tasks and contributor pages link to the owning workflow and distinguish generic engine subtask approval from final whole-PR review.
- Rationale and limits state that the admin profile bypasses GitHub enforcement. Formal approving review is optional; the App merge endpoint and ruleset change are deferred.
- Full deterministic impact evidence covers every planned path in .loop/planned-paths.json.
- Documentation generation and lint pass; commit any generated context changes.

**Acceptance:** Review the prepared pages against the 2026-10-01 group decision; finish any missing documentation before handoff. Run the planned-path impact command and composer docs-build and composer docs-lint. Run npx mint validate and npx mint broken-links from docs for the changed links, recording any existing unrelated failure. No product code, live GitHub policy change, PR comment, or merge is part of this subtask.

deliverables.description: Final comment, exact-head merge, consent delegation, bypass limits, and deferred alternatives are documented
Settling links to the external final-review workflow; the Gateway still only watches merges
Contributors can find the delegated final-review and merge requirements
Documentation generation and strict lint pass

deliverables.command: python3 -c 'import json,subprocess; p=json.load(open(".loop/planned-paths.json")); subprocess.run(["bin/docs-impact","--base","0f493f3f505815da3b1d800ab2afeb26d4f5e32f"]+[v for path in p for v in ("--paths",path)],check=True)'
deliverables.description: Complete impact report covers the planned paths; reviewer confirms required pages are present

tasks.title: Apply and verify the DevOps final-review and merge guidance
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** The DevOps reviewer can apply the documented gate and merge the reviewed commit using the maintainer's GitHub CLI profile.

**Contract:** docs/reference/implementation-loop.md#final-review-of-an-orbit-task-pull-request; .agents/skills/reviewing-pull-requests/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/merging-pull-requests/SKILL.md.

**Builds on:** ORB-678's complete, reviewed documentation contract.

**Deliverables:**
- Review guidance posts a final GitHub comment only when delegated/authorized, with full current head SHA, whole-PR assessment, evidence/results/limitations, and an explicit merge verdict.
- Merge guidance verifies the final comment covers the current head, successful Required checks on that head, resolved findings, complete required verification, and authorization for this PR; it uses gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit through the maintainer profile and verifies the merge result.
- A scenario walkthrough in .loop/merge-workflow-proof.md records allowed and refused cases: unchanged green reviewed head; new head or conflict fix; comment for a different head; missing final verdict; pending/failed/missing/unreadable checks; incomplete required review evidence; missing authorization; unresolved findings or known main correctness failure. Label walkthrough evidence accurately; do not claim a live merge was proved.
- Read-only gh help/repository inspection confirms command flag availability and records the current bypass and auto-merge settings without changing them. No live fixture or production merge is needed for this documentation-only group.
- Review the prepared skills against the contract, finish gaps, check links/wording, and record limitations at handoff.

**Acceptance:** Run git diff --check and composer docs-lint; inspect gh pr merge --help. Verify every scenario against the skills and documentation, and ensure head movement never falls back to merging the current head. Confirm no product code, API/SDK/MCP/CLI schema, GitHub policy, or App permission changed. Preserve the separate primary-workspace orbit-tasks edit. Complete the focused PR through the existing task publisher; independent review still applies. Do not merge a live PR as a demonstration.

deliverables.description: Maintainer-profile merge checks final review and green CI, and binds merge to the reviewed SHA
Authorized final DevOps review records a whole-PR verdict for the exact head in a GitHub comment
Accurately labeled scenario walkthrough and read-only GitHub/CLI observations record results and limits

deliverables.command: git diff --check && composer docs-lint && gh pr merge --help
deliverables.description: Diff and docs checks pass; installed gh exposes the documented merge command flags
Reviewer confirms scenario results, exact-head/CI/authorization stop conditions, and that no live policy or product changes were introduced
